mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sys_menu ORDER BY parent_id, sort
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_menu WHERE parent_id = #{parentId}
SELECT DISTINCT m.* FROM sys_menu m INNER JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON m.id = rm.menu_id INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON rm.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY m.parent_id, m.sort
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_menu(parent_id, menu_type, menu_name, path, perm_code, icon, sort) VALUES(#{parentId}, #{menuType}, #{menuName}, #{path}, #{permCode}, #{icon}, #{sort})
